observations.epoch_band_state_and_other_notes: ASKAP EMU discovery 2023-06-15; 760 +/- 40 uJy is the reported continuum-image flux, not a burst peak. Individual Table B1 Stokes-I burst fluxes and signed polarizations are in the ledger. MeerKAT position is published as J2000, not Gaia J2016 astrometry. Mo+26 confirms a CV with Porb=98.6 +4.2/-4.1 min (68% credible interval); radio recurrence 93.8513 +/- 0.0008 min is a plausible, potentially nonunique timing solution. No Gaia counterpart in the discovery-paper search; no adopted distance, WD spin or surface field. XMM model fluxes are preserved with absorption/model distinctions; fixed catalogue bands are unfilled.

issues.competing_evidence: CV established; polar proposed; no Zeeman/cyclotron field or He II high-state signature.
issues.why_it_matters: Avoid treating a candidate polar as a measured magnetic subtype.
issues.needed_action: Obtain deeper/state-resolved spectroscopy and field diagnostics.

issues.competing_evidence: No Gaia distance; pre-bounce/bouncer models require different donors and distances.
issues.why_it_matters: Illustrative SED parameters are not measured component values.
issues.needed_action: Measure distance and characterize donor; retain model alternatives.

issues.parameter: Radio clock identification and timing uniqueness
issues.competing_evidence: Radio 93.8513(8) min consistent with optical 98.6 +4.2/-4.1 min; timing solution may be nonunique.
issues.why_it_matters: Radio/orbital agreement does not establish WD spin, beat or synchronization.
issues.needed_action: Obtain additional TOAs and optical RVs; test aliases and phase connection.

issues.competing_evidence: ATCA Tables 1/B1 and Fig. 3 say 2024-06-27; section 2.1.2 says 2024-07-15. Table B1 says 2025-12-25 at MJD 60669 (2024-12-25). Table 2 lists 20 TOAs/MJD 60110-60522; section 3.1 and Mo+26 Appendix A say 18 TOAs.
issues.why_it_matters: Date and TOA selection errors affect observation matching and timing replication.
issues.needed_action: Check original observing logs/TOAs or author clarification; retain table values with explicit caveats.

issues.parameter: X-ray flux band and model selection
issues.competing_evidence: Table 4 supplies absorbed/unabsorbed fits for three models and free/fixed NH without an explicit integration band.
issues.why_it_matters: Cannot populate fixed 1-10 or 0.1-10 keV columns from an unspecified band.
issues.needed_action: Confirm fit-flux integration band and confidence convention; retain all model alternatives.

cmd.exclusion_reason: No secure Gaia counterpart / complete BP, RP and G photometry; no assumed WD or distance
cmd.uncertainty_method: Recorded distance endpoints transformed nonlinearly at fixed G; retain the recorded interval convention, including unspecified conventions. Posterior quantiles are not Gaussian errors. Photometric error separate. Color error, where both available, approximates independent BP/RP errors in quadrature; covariance and variability ignored.
cmd.qualifications: Host/subclass candidate or disputed; inspect source evidence
